description: Currency reference rates. Use when a task needs today's European Central Bank reference exchange rates for about 30 major currencies (AUD, USD, GBP, JPY, NZD, CAD, CNY and others) against any of them as base, for information such as estimates or reports, not for transactions. The ECB publishes the euro rates free of charge on its website. Cost: 1 credit per call.

base.description: Three-letter code to quote the rates against. Defaults to EUR, the currency the ECB publishes.

name: currency_rates
